property_summary: After any admissible call to newGrantProposal, the state variable proposalCount remains unchanged in the mutant, while it correctly increments in the reference.

After any number of calls to newGrantProposal, proposalCount always equals the number of proposals created (accessible via mapPID_type entries); the bug increments by 2 instead of 1, causing proposalCount to be strictly greater than the count of non-empty mapPID_type slots when at least one call is made.

After any sequence of newGrantProposal calls, the proposalCount getter equals the highest proposal ID for which a grant was actually stored in mapPID_grant; in the buggy mutant, calling newGrantProposal once stores the grant at an ID exceeding proposalCount, so proposalCount does not correspond to the ID of the stored grant.
After initialization, the VADER getter returns the _vader address, not the _usdv address.
